title: The Latest Crier for Apr 04, 2026
items:
The St. Mary's Catholic Church shuttle bus will NOT run this Sunday 4-5-26.

The shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass will NOT run this Sunday 4/5/26. The Shuttle Bus will resume service on Sunday April 12, 2026, have a great Easter Break. 

If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu.

Trade Snow for Sun: Merida, Mexico (Jan 4 - 15, 2027)

Looking for an unforgettable way to spend Winter Break? Join our faculty-led trip to Merida, Mexico ( January 4 - 15, 2027 ), and immerse yourself in the language, culture, and everyday life of the Yucatan Peninsula. 

Enroll in SPAN 160/260/360/460 – Language & Culture in Yucatan (1 - 4 credits) during Fall 2026 , and travel with the class to Merida, Mexico over winter break in January 2027 for an immersive cultural and language experience. 

No matter your Spanish level, this course invites you to engage deeply with local culture, strengthen your language skills, and explore one of Mexico’s most vibrant and historic cities. 

Interested? Contact Prof. Oscar Reynaga (reynagao@central.edu) for more information.

Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement

Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

Common Ground Charity Drag Show

Common Ground is hosting their annual Charity Drag Show on April 11th!! Featuring Ivy LaVoix (Central Alum), Tomi Saint James, Shae P. Shifter, and many more performers. Doors open at 7:30p. This is an 18+ event and a cash bar is available for those 21 years and older - bring tips for our charities, Iowa Trans Mutual Aid Fund and Iowa MMJ (Migrant Movement for Justice). See you in Graham Conference Center

Food Eating Contest

Think you’ve got what it takes? 
Join CAB for an exciting Food Eating Contest on Friday, April 10 from 7–9 PM in Graham Annex! 

Students are invited to join in on the fun, whether competing or cheering on friends, as participants race against the clock to see who can eat the most and claim bragging rights. 

Go head-to-head against friends to see who can claim the top prize. Prizes will be awarded to the top eaters, so bring your appetite and your competitive spirit!
